selection_rules.small_single_piece: single-piece admin with polygon area closest to 50 km2
selection_rules.median_single_piece: single-piece admin with area closest to the all-admin median (also split into 2 halves for batching invariance)
selection_rules.island_coastal: Cabo Verde admin closest to the Cabo Verde median area (water/mask edge, coverage near .80)
selection_rules.cross_zone_overlap: 500-5000 km2 admin spanning >=2 UTM zones with the largest footprint-overlap share (ownership/first-owner test)
selection_rules.multipolygon: lowest admin_code MultiPolygon (>=2 parts) with 100-3000 km2
selection_rules.all_masked_fixture: first listed open-ocean coordinate (geographic knowledge) inside a tile footprint and >1 degree from every admin; 2x2 km square; not an admin
